Name: Bridge in Standard Farm (CP)
Author: SkrillzPlayz
Description:
I was looking for a bridge mod but some didn't look good or were broken, so I made my own using the game's art to keep the Stardew Valley feeling.

The bridge lines up with the mountain and forest for those with OCD like me.

You can place crab pots on the side! (Cannot build on the bridge, I couldn't figure out how.)

It uses Content Patcher, so it should work on future versions, if not, let me know!

[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Install Content Patcher, following the same install instructions above.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Bridge in Standard Farm
Manifest.Description: Adds a bridge over the pond in the standard farm.
